components.name: Primary Brand Button
components.description: High-contrast pill CTA for primary conversion actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00d2ee 0%, #0284c7 100%); color: #041021; font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-brand:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-brand:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Studio Button
components.description: Secondary action button with crisp 1px rim border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0f1219; color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 22px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(0,210,238,0.5); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

rules.name: The Single-Accent Discipline Rule
rules.body: Brand cyan and sapphire lead primary actions and active states; never introduce unmotivated purple/indigo AI gradients or decorative gradient fills on headings.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Headings earn emphasis through scale, tight tracking, and stark contrast — never gradient text clips or uppercase kicker tags.

rules.name: The Single Elevation Declaration Rule
rules.body: Never stack heavy drop shadows beneath high-contrast borders on resting cards; declare elevation once through clean rim borders or tonal stepping.

dos: Do keep Web Design & Development first and active by default across #work and /portfolio (no All Work tab).
Do route all public data reads and form submissions through the Custom PHP MVC /api/v1/*, /api/contact, /api/support, and /api/chat/* endpoints.
Do gate hover-lift transforms inside @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add eyebrow/kicker tags above headings, gradient text on headings, or emoji icons anywhere in the UI.
Don't introduce third-party script marketplace links (Codester, CodeGrape, SellAnyCode).
Don't animate interactive UI elements from scale(0) or with sluggish ease-in curves.
